name: Kahaan Hum Kahaan Tum
description: A chance encounter brings together Dr. Rohit and TV actress Sonakshi. Starting off on a wrong foot, they soon fall in love and begin a life-changing journey.

videos.title: Meet Sonakshi and Rohit
videos.overview: Sonakshi Rastogi opens up about her life as an actress, while Rohit Sippy, a surgeon, recalls his past after receiving an award. How will their lives get entwined?

videos.title: Rani Rebukes Pooja
videos.overview: Suman assigns Pari a task after learning about Sonakshi's resignation from KPK. Elsewhere, Rani rebukes Pooja while Rohan discovers the secret tracker in his car.

videos.title: Sonakshi is Stunned
videos.overview: Sonakshi is shocked to learn about Rohit's secret meeting with Rani. Elsewhere, Pooja is in tears as Rani attempts to slap her and creates a scene.

videos.overview: Rohit supports Sonakshi when Naren berates her. While Sonakshi slaps Rani at the hospital, the Sippys celebrate the new year.

videos.overview: A guilt-ridden Rohit apologises to Sonakshi, but she is not ready to forgive him. While the Sippys celebrate New Year, Rohit drops a bombshell on Sonakshi.

videos.title: Sonakshi's Solemn Promise
videos.overview: Sonakshi promises to keep Naren's affair a secret. While Veena gets Naren to wish Sonakshi for New Year, Nishi is enraged with Rohit for telling the truth.

videos.title: Sonakshi Gets Blackmailed!
videos.overview: An unknown man blackmails Sonakshi about revealing Naren's secret to Veena. While Rohit rushes to the hospital, the blackmailer sends Veena a parcel.

videos.title: Rohit, Sonakshi's Special Bond
videos.overview: The blackmailer decides to teach Sonakshi a lesson for double-crossing him. While Rohit is thankful to Sonakshi for her help, Suman notices an alarming fact.

videos.title: A Shock Awaits Sonakshi
videos.overview: Rohan panics after finding a hidden camera. While Rohit learns about Sonakshi's secret from Suman, Sonakshi is left speechless upon catching the blackmailer.

videos.title: A Shocker For The Sippys
videos.overview: An intoxicated Ajit unintentionally reveals Naren's secret to Suman. Elsewhere, Veena and Sonakshi are shocked to learn about Rohan and Pari's affair.

videos.title: Suman Drops a Truth Bomb
videos.overview: Rohit vents his frustration on Sonakshi while a furious Veena slaps Pari. During the party at the Sippys', Suman discloses a scandalous truth.

videos.title: Veena, Stunned By The Truth
videos.overview: A heartbroken Veena falls unconscious upon learning about Naren's affair. While Suman refuses to let Sonakshi enter the house, Rohit slaps Veena!

videos.title: Rohit Hates Sonakshi?
videos.overview: Sonakshi takes the blame on herself to protect Ajit. While Rohit vents his anger out on Sonakshi for deceiving him, Nishi vows to destroy her.

videos.title: Naren's Shocking Move
videos.overview: Tanya gets Pari arrested. While Naren makes a surprising announcement, Rohan's decision to divorce Tanya stuns the Sippys.

videos.title: Nishi's Sinister Act
videos.overview: While Sonakshi requests Naren to reconsider his decision, Tanya threatens Rohan. Later, Nishi attempts to kill Naren to acquire his property.

videos.title: Sonakshi is In Trouble?
videos.overview: Sonakshi feels helpless when Nishi tries to frame Naren's suicide attempt on her. Later, a distressed Veena asks the police to interrogate Sonakshi.

videos.title: Nishi Provokes Veena
videos.overview: Nishi gets irked when Rohit supports Sonakshi. Later, Veena falls prey to Nishi's manipulation when she provokes her against Sonakshi.

videos.title: Rohit Berates Sonakshi
videos.overview: Rohit vents his anger out on Sonakshi after learning about the prenup. While Nishi relishes the success of her plan, Sonakshi receives an alarming news.

videos.title: Sonakshi's Shocking Stand
videos.overview: Sonakshi's life is in peril during a heated argument with Rohit. Devastated, she puts forth a condition when he demands a divorce.

videos.title: Sonakshi Gets a Vital Clue
videos.overview: Rohit surprises Sonakshi by attending a party in her honour. She is stunned when the police show her a shocking video regarding Naren's murder.

videos.title: Rohit Mocks Sonakshi
videos.overview: During the event in Sonakshi's honour, an intoxicated Rohit calls her fake on the stage. While Pari learns that she is pregnant, the police give Sonakshi shocking news.

videos.title: Sonakshi's Baffling Discovery
videos.overview: Sonakshi gets a vital clue and searches Nishi's room. While Rohit tries to get in touch with Sonakshi, YK catches her leaving his room.

videos.title: Sonakshi Confronts Nishi
videos.overview: Sonakshi confronts Nishi for trying to kill Naren. While Nishi tries to turn the tables on Sonakshi, the latter discloses Nishi's evil deeds to Veena.

videos.title: Nishi Attempts Suicide?
videos.overview: The Sippys lose their cool on Sonakshi while she gets shocking news about the inspector. After creating a huge drama, Nishi decides to commit suicide.

videos.title: Rohit Finds The Truth?
videos.overview: While Ajit reveals a shocking truth to Rohit, Nishi challenges to oust Sonakshi from the house. Later, Nishi tries to prevent Rohit from learning about her misdeeds.

videos.title: Will Rohit Divorce Sonakshi?
videos.overview: Nishi controls Naren's pacemaker via her phone and makes a shocking threat to Rohit. Later, Veena demands that Rohit divorce Sonakshi.

videos.title: Ronakshi Part Ways
videos.overview: After facing unthinkable charges, a heartbroken Sonakshi slaps Rohit and leaves the Sippy Mansion. Later, she meets with a terrible accident.

videos.title: Rohit's Wild Hallucination
videos.overview: While Mahesh informs Nishi regarding Sonakshi's accident, a drunk Rohit hallucinates about the latter. Later, Suman brings cops to the Sippy Mansion and slaps Rohit.

videos.title: Sonakshi's Drastic Change
videos.overview: While Rohit arrives at the OT completely intoxicated, Pari spikes Tanya's food. Later, Sonakshi challenges to surpass Rohit in terms of money and respect.

videos.title: Sonakshi's New Struggle
videos.overview: Four months later, financial reasons stop Sonakshi from getting Suman released on bail. While Rohit notices a disturbing sight, Pari struggles to hide her secret.

videos.title: Rohit's Unexpected Move
videos.overview: Rohit is infuriated to spot Sonakshi dancing at his friend's bachelor party. While she feels helpless, he gives a shocking verdict against Suman in the court.

videos.title: Rohit's Shocking Discovery
videos.overview: On Valentine's day, Rohit sends a balloon to Sonakshi. While the Sippys celebrate Tanya's baby shower, he is shocked to learn about Pari's pregnancy.

videos.title: Rohit Saves Sonakshi?
videos.overview: Rohan plans to abort Pari's unborn child while a producer spikes Sonakshi's drink. Later, Rohit attempts to stop Sonakshi from embarrassing herself.

videos.title: A Shocker For Sonakshi
videos.overview: Suman asks Sumit to propose to Sonakshi while Rohan drugs Pari. Later, Sonakshi is stunned by Rohit's confession.

videos.title: Sonakshi Confronts Rohit
videos.overview: Sonakshi confronts Rohit. Later, as the Sippys learn about Pari's pregnancy, Tanya meets with a deadly mishap.

videos.title: Rohit's Heroic Move
videos.overview: Sonakshi is shocked by Suman's decision regarding Pari's baby. Later, Rohit heroically steps in when a frantic Tanya attacks Sonakshi.

videos.title: Sonakshi Moves On?
videos.overview: Sumit is surprised by Sonakshi's interest in starting a relationship with him. While Rohit tries to contain an airborne disease, Sonakshi does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Sonakshi's Dreadful Condition
videos.overview: A jealous Rohit grabs Sumit's collar at a bar. While Sonakshi's health suddenly deteriorates, Rohit learns that she might be infected with a deadly virus.

videos.title: Sonakshi is Adamant
videos.overview: Sonakshi threatens to commit suicide when Rohit tries to help her. While Tanya is diagnosed with PTSD, Nishi gets a shocking piece of information about Naren.

videos.title: Rohit is Heartbroken
videos.overview: Rohit is shattered when Sonakshi's reports state that she has the super virus. While Nishi threatens Naren, Sumit and Rohit are unable to find Sonakshi.

videos.title: Rohit is On a Warpath
videos.overview: Rohit learns the truth about Sonakshi after searching Nishi's office. While Rohan visits Pari, Rohit threatens to kill Nishi if anything happens to Sonakshi.

videos.title: Rohit Suspects Nishi
videos.overview: Suman apologises to Rohit for misunderstanding him. While Rohit suspects Nishi, Sonakshi struggles to escape from Veena's trap.

videos.title: Rohit's Shocking Discovery
videos.overview: Rohit is stunned to discover that Sonakshi's blood may potentially be the cure for the supervirus. Later, Nishi learns a shocking truth about Sonakshi's abduction.

videos.title: Sonakshi's Brave Step
videos.overview: Sonakshi agrees to undergo a dangerous procedure for the supervirus antidote on one condition. Later, she makes an odd request as a nurse informs her of the risks.

videos.title: Sonakshi's Life At Stake?
videos.overview: Sonakshi's health begins to rapidly deteriorate after the supervirus is artificially injected into her body. Elsewhere, Tanya learns a shocking truth about her pregnancy.

videos.title: Rohit Gets Nostalgic
videos.overview: A dejected Rohit recalls the romantic moments spent with Sonakshi. While Rohan makes an unethical request to Pari, Sonakshi learns a shocking truth about Rohit.

videos.title: Sonakshi's Bold Move
videos.overview: Pari agrees to give her child to Tanya under one shocking condition. While Nishi rejoices Rohit's waning health, Sonakshi comes up with an idea to meet him.

videos.title: A Shocker For Sonakshi
videos.overview: Sonakshi approaches Rohit in disguise but he recognises her immediately. While he drops into a comatose state, Sonakshi learns a shocking fact.

videos.title: Rohit Breathes His Last?
videos.overview: A disguised Sumit helps Sonakshi execute her plan but Nishi suspects foul play. While Sonakshi is stuck inside the lift, Rohit is declared dead by the doctors.

videos.title: Rohit, Sonakshi Join Hands
videos.overview: Nishi is stunned to learn that Rohit is out of danger. Later, Rohit spills some shocking beans to Sonakshi, and they join hands against Nishi.

videos.title: Sonakshi Enters The Sippy Mansion
videos.overview: Rohit and Sonakshi share a special moment after he brings her back to the Sippy mansion. On the other hand, Pooja makes a startling discovery.

videos.title: Sonakshi Exposes Nishi
videos.overview: Rohan scolds Tanya for berating Pari while Nishi suspects foul play about Parvati's identity. Later, Sonakshi reveals Nishi's misdeeds in front of the family.

videos.title: Nishi is Irritated
videos.overview: While Sonakshi leaves the house, an infuriated Veena throws Rohan out of the Sippy mansion. Later, Nishi is irritated over Pooja's horrifying blunder.

videos.title: Ronakshi's Fairytale Ending
videos.overview: Veena unleashes her rage onto Nishi after the latter's misdeeds are exposed. As peace is restored, all ends well for RoNakshi.
